notes.title: 3 days left in the Kickstarter campaign + AMA on Reddit!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959584/cb0d748dc940972d41fc03cf079679f0d52641a4.jpg[/img]

Just 3 days left until the end of the campaign, Runa has been trending on Kickstarter for almost a month now, with [b]over 600% funded and 4700 backers[/b] currently supporting the project.

Furthermore, we've achieved nine stretch goals, which will add exciting features to the game, including [b]new minigames, new maps, new characters and Emi Evans[/b] as a guest vocalist! There are only three days left for exclusive rewards, so take a look and consider supporting us to make the game the best it can be.

In addition to that, today we'll be hosting an [b]Ask Me Anything[/b] on the r/JRPG subreddit, so make sure to stop by if you have any questions!

Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/runarpg/runa?ref=2i1i8b

Reddit AMA (r/JRPG): https://www.reddit.com/r/JRPG/comments/1cr88n3


Best regards everyone!

notes.title: Runa is now live on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aVhEFdS.png[/img]

Runa has officially [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/runarpg/runa]launched on Kickstarter[/url]! The support from this campaign is really important for our development, so be sure to take a look and consider supporting the game. 

The Kickstarter campaign will run for 30 days, ending on May 16. There are backer exclusive rewards, backer limited rewards and early bird tiers. All of these are unique to the campaign.

The development keeps going smoothly, and we are confident that the campaign can be a success and will enable us to launch a product that aligns more closely with our vision.

Thank you for your support.

Runa Development Team
